༄༅/ /drang srong khros pa'i gtor bzlog bcud phur bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ri ṣi kro dhā ya/'dir man ngag zab mo'i chos sde rig pa 'dzin pa'i snyi

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drang srong khros pa'i gtor bzlog bcud phur bzhugs so/

/na mo gu ru ri ṣi kro dhā ya/ 'dir man ngag zab mo'i chos sde rig pa 'dzin pa'i snying thig las/ sa bcad drug pa drang srong dri med mthing nag la brten nas mngon spyod dmod pa'i las brtsam pa ni/ mdun du phung sa'i hom nang dgra bgegs ling ga gzhug /de steng maṇḍal 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i khar dmar gtor gtso 'khor dgu pa sha khrag mtshe yungs sogs kyis brgyan pa/ /drag mchod dang*/ thun rdzas thun gtor bcas bshams/ thog mar mdun du skyabs yul gsal la/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs/ yan lag brgyad pa byas nas tshogs zhing rang la thim par bsam/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ /stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul kun/ /dag pa rab 'byams zhing khams cher/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdag mdun bsgom pa ni/ shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /rdo rje srung ba'i gur chen dbus/ /ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi/ /chos srung rgya mtsho sprin phung 'khrigs/ /de dbus pad nyi dgra bgegs steng*/ lokt+ri pā la shin tu 'jigs/ /mthing nag dbu brgya phyag stong 'bar/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs gdengs/ /de yi thugs kar drang srong khros/ /ye shes phyag bzhi mchan sems dpa'i sprul skur bzhengs/ /de yi thugs dkar dri med zhi/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul/ /de yi thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos kyi sku dang dbyer med bzhugs/ mdun du gnam lcags 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad rno ngar ldan pa'i dbus/ /pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng*/ /mngon spyod dmod pa stobs kyi lha/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /'jig rten sgrol mdzad sku mdog mthing*/ /phyag bzhi tho ba ral gri dang*/ /tha gnyis gnam lcags phyag mthil la/ /lcags sdig sor mo 'bar ba gdengs/ /gcer bu rgyan med shin tu 'jigs/

/ye shes me dpung dor thabs rol/ /rtsibs brgyad rang 'dra'i sprul pa brgyad/ /spyi bor rigs bdag pad 'byung dang*/ /thugs kar drang srong dri med bzhugs/ /mtha' bskor ye shes 'jig rten gyi/ /chos srung rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs/ /bdag dang mdun gyi lha tshogs kyi/ /gnas gsum de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo ni/ /yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur/ badzra sa ma dza: dza:hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhanaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs las/ /mkha' khyab 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gter/ /bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol/ /sarba pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin/ /drang srong zhe sdang rdo rje ni/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thog mar srung dmigs ni/ thugs srog hūm̐ gi thig le dang*/ /bsrung bya'i sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres/ /mi shigs gsum ldan 'od zer sprin/ /me mtshon khro bo'i tshul du 'phros/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes/ /gnod byed 'byung po rdul du brlag /byad phur rbod gtong dbyings su bzlog /thams cad rig rtsal gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /tshur 'dus thugs srog thig ler thim/ /byin rlabs nus stobs 'bar bar gyur/ ces pa'i don la dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ oṃ log tri pā la nan srungs/ sa ga pa sha nan srungs/ nā ga du du nan srungs/ ma maṃ ma maṃ srungs/ tsi tsar tsi tsar srungs/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu srungs/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya srungs/ ho ra ho ra nan srungs/ tsi du sod tsi du sod/ shig lhur gtubs/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba thul/ gnod byed 'byung po kā wā tsi brlag brlag nri bhrūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ ma ma sarba rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: zhes ci rigs bzla zhing stong tshig gi mchod bstod bya'o/

/de ltar rang rdo rje'i gur du zhugs nas phas rgol gzhom pa'i las dngos la 'jug pa ni gzhung las/ 'og tu gnam lcags khang spros dbus/ /dgra bgegs byad ma dngos su gsal/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hos dbyer med bstim/ /mdun bskyed phyag mtshan tho ba dang*/ ral gri'i char babs bsad bcad gtub/ /sor mo'i lcags sdig grangs med pas/ /sha khrag hab hab zos par bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lag tu len pa la/ thog mar gser skyems ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ /khyad par zhe sdang rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes sogs dang gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /drang srong khros pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dang dpang por mdzod/ bsdu na de tsam dang*/ spro na gzu dpang gzhan yang bya'o/ /de nas e khang bskyed pa sogs ni/ /mdun 'og dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba yi/ /e las gzhal yas lcags khang sgo med pa'i/ /nang du gru gsum nag po gting zab pa/ /de dbus nri las gnod byed byad ma rnams/ /mgon med mya ngan phyag rgya can du gyur/ zhes gsal btab la/ na mo rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa dang*/ /khyad par mngon spyod dmod pa stobs kyi lha/ /drang srong khros pa zhe sdang rdo rje'i sku/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin smod/ /chos byed yongs la 'tshe ba dam sri'i dpung*/ /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad phur rbod gtong dang*/ /'gal rkyen bar chad rtsom pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/

/gang na yod kyang dmigs rten 'di nyid la/ /khug cig badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ/ /ske nas chings shig badzra pā sha hūm̐/ /yan lag sdoms shig badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ /myos par gyis shig badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ /phyes shig badzra pra be shā ya phaṭa/ /dbyer med bstims shig ā be sha ya āḥ zhes dang nan che na bla 'gugs kyi sngags kyang ci rigs bzla'o/ /de nas bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni/ /mdun bskyed phyag mtshan gnam lcags tho ba dang*/ /ral gri'i char ba thog gi bu yug bzhin/ /dgra bgegs byad ma'i steng du dbab pa yis/ /lus srog dbang po dum bur gcod cing gtubs/ /sor mo lcags kyi sdig pa grangs med pas/ /sha khrag ma lus hab hab zos par gyur/ zhes bsad pa'i dm-igs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ log tri pā la nan/ sa ga pa sha nan/ nā ga du du nan/ ma maṃ ma maṃ/ tsi tsar tsi tsar/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu/ rbad tra ko sha ya/ rbad trag ko sha ya/ ho ra ho ra nan/ tsi du sod/ tsi du sod/ shig lhur gtub/ ha la ba ti nan/ 'khor ba thul/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po kā bā tsi brlag brlag /thum ril myogs rmugs mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces brag kha nas chu 'bab pa ltar bzla/ thun mthar thun rdzas la bsngags shing*/ thun gtab pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ /klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /zhes byas la sngags ring dang drang srong dmod pa tshar gcig bcas thun brdeg cing*/ bsgral ba'i sha khrag rnams dang*/ thun gtor bcas la rakta bran te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha yi ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma hā ri ṣi kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ /khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/

/gsod pa la sogs rtag tu brtson/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing gdul dka' 'dul/ /'khor bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa nang khrol tshogs/ /lhun por spungs pa'i 'dod rgu'i ba ling ta/ /phyi nang nyer spyod sman raka bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /'bul lo dgyes par rol la bdag cag gi /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal longs spyod spel/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung*/ /thams cad ming gi lhag mar tshar chod cig /phas rgol bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad stems dpung*/ /thams cad rang gshed phob la mthu nus shig /lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa rnams/ /nam yang ldang med brlag pa'i las mdzod cig /mdor na bdag gi re 'bras gang yin pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /zhes thun gtor 'bul/ de nas bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi 'khor rnams zhal phyir gzigs shing bzlog sngags bzlas pa dang lhan cig tu rang 'dra'i sprul pa dang las byed nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros pas mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog par bsams la/ oṃ lokt+ri pā la nan sogs nas/ kā wa tsi brlag brlag /dgra bgegs byad ma la srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /ces ci nus bzlas la/ mthar dmod pa dang bcas thal mo brdab pa'i bar du byad ma 'khor bcas sgo nga brag bar bcar ba ltar ming med du brlag par bsam la/ na mo/ /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs nas/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das drang srong khro bo'i rgyal po zhe sdang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen ngan pa thams cad dang khyad par ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad/

rbad 'dre rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /srid pa spyi nas shig cig /srid gsum rmangs nas bsgyel cig /'khor ba gting nas phyungs shig /bskal pa'i mes sregs shig /dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shig /bka' yi chad pa chod cig /gnam lcags ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig /sum bha nis non cig /srid gsum gar skyes kyang sdig can 'di'i steng du gnam lcags rdo rje'i char chen po phob cig /gnod byed sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'dis thul cig: zhes bden stobs brjod pa dang dmod pas gzir zhing thal mo brdab pa lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: zhal gdams snying byang raksha thod phreng gi bzlog pa/ mchan/ mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong : tsakra 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag: zhe sdang rdorje dbyings nas bzhengs: sprul pa'i khro tshogs las la chos: yang sprul khro bo khro mo dang : drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon 'chang ba: lokt+ri pa las stong khams gang : dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'di nas tshig rkang bdun kha skong*/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i: dgra gyod mi kha dmod byad dang : sde brgyad gdug rtsub cho 'phrul dang : than dang ltas ngan dal yams dang : chags che nyams nga 'jigs pa'i tshogs: nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgas gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang : glo bur rtsub pa'i bgegs rigs kun: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bzlog:

bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la bsgyur: zlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas gang du 'phen pa'i phyogs su gser skyems dang gzu dpang sngon du 'gro bas/ dmigs bya'i rū pa la dgug gzhug bya zhing de 'ben du bcas la zor 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐/ /gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs/ /bstan pa'i ru dra ma gtogs pa'i/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi/ /lha klu gzhi bdag sku bzur cig /gtor zor dgra bgegs snying la rgyob/ yig rnying las so/ 'di man gsar rtsom/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa drag po'i rtsal/ /drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon char yongs shar ba/ /dmar chen gtor zor gdug pa'i dug dbal can/ /dam nyams sdig can bstan dgra'i snying la 'phen/ /rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs kyi mthu bskyed la/ /snang srid sde brgyad dreg pa las la bhyo/ /gang la brnags pa'i dgra bgegs snying la ya/ /rjes shul med par thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rbad thuṃ ri li li/ /zhes dang sngags ring dang dmod pa'i mthar/ tril shag srog khyer bhyo/ tri myags ka pa ya: slar yang srung 'khor bsgom zhing nang du log la/ drang srong zhi ba'i tshe 'gugs bya zhing las rjes spyi ltar bya'o/ /gzhan yang spro na tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs drang srong zhi ba'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes sku/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshul 'chang mdo sngags gling*/ /gang gi zhal lung zab mo'i man ngag 'di/ /thob cing rjes su gnang bas 'di bris so/ /grub pa'i byin rlabs mi shigs rdo rje'i mtshon/ /mi bzod dmod pa drag po'i rno dbal can/ /sdig can snying la bsnun pas bdud sde'i g.yul/ pha mthar byed 'di bstan pa'i btsas su shog /zhes pa'ang rigs kun khyab bdag gter chen bla ma mchog gi zhal snga nas tshul 'di'i smin grol nos shing gtor bzlog gi rim pa 'di lta bu'i chog khrigs gyis zhes rjes su gnang ba la brten nas bla ma'i bran du gyur pa mi pham rnam par rgyal bas bris pa 'dis 'gro kun bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal zhing dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig
